Connect to the jnanalytics tables

Source: R/source.R
jn_source.Rd

The analysis functions read from a source: a folder of Parquet files as written by jn_publish() or downloaded from Hugging Face, or the BigQuery dataset. A table is either one file (journal_year.parquet) or a folder of files (articles/articles_2025.parquet, ...); a download of only some tables or years works too.

Usage

jn_source(x = "parquet", config = jn_bq_config())

jn_tbl(src, table)

Arguments

x

A directory with Parquet files, or "bigquery".

config

See jn_bq_config(). Used for BigQuery only.

src

A jn_source.

table

Table name, see jn_tables().

Value

A jn_source object. jn_tbl() returns one of its tables as a lazy table that dplyr verbs can be applied to.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# hf download najkoja/jn_analytics --repo-type dataset --local-dir jn_data
src <- jn_source("jn_data")
jn_tbl(src, "journal_year")
jn_tbl(src, "articles") |>
  dplyr::filter(issn_l == "0360-0300", pub_year == 2025) |>
  dplyr::collect()

bq <- jn_source("bigquery")
jn_tbl(bq, "articles") |>
  dplyr::filter(issn_l == "0360-0300", pub_year == 2025) |>
  dplyr::collect()
} # }
